resources.string: No library on this phone yet.\n\nType caracole serve\'s address in Settings, then sync: the phone keeps a copy of your library and reads it with no network.
caracole answered: %1$d files, %2$s (%3$d listed wrong, left out)
Every 6 hours on Wi-Fi (an unmetered network), when caracole answers at the address; otherwise it does nothing.

Offline, the app shows the pages caracole writes into your library: the library page, each sheet with its viewer (key, capo, diagrams, harmony), songbooks, and the PDFs and Guitar Pro files, which open in another app. Searching the sites, adding songs, Export and choosing versions need caracole serve, in the browser.
